configuration: Leica EM ACE600 base benchtop instrument, closed and dormant

references.title: Leica EM ACE600 technical data sheet (10/20)
references.caption: OEM sheet, reproduced by its distributor. Cover photographs the configurable cabinet; page 2 is the side/face drawing with an extended transfer assembly; page 4 lists the basic instrument dimensions and shows why transfer variants are excluded here.

references.title: Johns Hopkins Beckman Center equipment photograph
references.caption: Front view of a closed installation. Establishes the white hood, large black viewing frame, paired hinge silhouettes and dark screen on the forward sloped plinth. Its pictured lateral modules are not included here.

references.title: Leica EM ACE600 product gallery
references.caption: Identifies the EM ACE600 model and optional variants. Exterior surfaces were reconstructed, not copied from CAD. The closed glass is intentionally opaque.
